scope: Water/no-water labels, not flood onset, agricultural impact, or inspection success.
protocol: NoData truth excluded only during scoring. Unknown predictions count as negatives in full recall/IoU. Rejected scenes are entirely unknown for both methods and remain in scoring. Baseline is unfiltered VH Otsu under the same input-admission policy.
notes: Input rejection and label alignment handling corrected after the first evaluation attempt stopped. Classifier thresholds were not changed. Test split now exposed; not event-disjoint. No inference speed or agricultural-impact claim.

cases.rejection: Too few valid calibrated radar pixels; check units and NoData.
